Qudenos is a red dragon who can be first encountered at the Mountain Pass. He serves  Kith'rak Voss, a legendary Githyanki knight in search of the  Mysterious Artefact.

“
Call me Qudenos. Master of Flames, Splitter of Skies.
„
— Qudenos providing proper introductions

Overview

Qudenos is a red dragon who has lived for many centuries, bearing the weight of uncounted battles. Under a pact with the goddess Tiamat, he serves as mount and companion to Kith'rak Voss.

Involvement

Act One

Qudenos can first be spotted flying around the Mountain Pass in his dragon form, when a party member uses the telescope at the Emerald Grove.

Upon reaching the pass, he flies overhead carrying Kith'rak Voss on his way to meet  Sarth Baretha and her fellow githyanki. The sight of Qudenos causes party members to become frightened unless they pass a saving throw. After speaking to Voss at the mountain pass, he and Qudenos fly off together.

Act Three

Qudenos, this time in his humanoid form as a dragonborn, and Voss can both be met later in the Lower City Sewers, if Voss is alive and the quest ⁠The Githyanki Warrior is in progress.

While speaking to Qudenos, he reveals that he is one among many red dragon rebels, loyal to the githyanki people but not to  Vlaakith. After freeing Orpheus, Qudenos plans to carry Voss into battle to defeat Vlaakith.

If attacked, Qudenos and Voss teleport away at their turn. However, even if Qudenos is killed before managing to teleport away, he can still be a potential ally in ⁠Gather Your Allies during ⁠Confront the Elder Brain.

Idle banter

Qudenos has an idle conversation with Voss inside the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

  • Qudenos
    Even with Prince Orpheus to guide us, we are too small in number to defeat Vlaakith alone.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    We will not be alone, Qudenos.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    For a thousand years, we have been planting the seeds of revolution.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    In every crèche, many young whisper Orpheus' name. They do Vlaakith's duty, but out of fear, not faith.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    When the Prince of the Comet blazes his path, they will follow. And so will countless others.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    The time is soon upon us, Qudenos. I will not forget your loyalty, friend.
  • Qudenos
    The lich queen has shackled the red dragons as surely as she has shackled the githyanki.
  • Qudenos
    You will be the first to battle. And I will be the one to carry you.
  • Qudenos
    This Lae'zel and her allies. Can they be trusted?
  • Kith'rak Voss
    You ask the wrong question. It is not a matter of 'can'. It is a matter of 'must'.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    Whether by fortune or necessity, fate made its choice.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    Lae'zel was the opportunity we prayed for. This may be our one chance to secure githyanki freedom.
